_readme: GR-2 evidence fixture — the audio response used by captures 01 and 06.
The chapter master is not in local storage, so the capture harness serves a
silent WAV and stubs this response. Everything here is declared fixture data.
Two fields are pinned by gr2-evidence-fixture.test.ts and must not drift:
metadata.title  — must carry the canonical chapter title, which is owned by
metadata.artist — the repository holds no authorship authority for this
book, so the fixture carries the contract's documented
no-author fallback instead of an unverified person's name.
